relationships.evidence_quote: It has been demonstrated that flavonoids prevent NLRP3 activation, which lowers the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines including IL-1β and IL-18

relationships.subject: Apigenin
relationships.evidence_quote: apigenin ameliorated diabetic neuropathy in rats by modulating the TLR4/MyD88 signalling pathway

key_findings: Review: flavonoids suppress NLRP3 inflammasome activation, caspase-1 and NF-κB in diabetic peripheral neuropathy, reducing IL-1β/IL-18 and neuropathic pain.
